typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	RunDate as timestamp (toTimestamp('9/11/2025 1:03:12 PM')),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PaymentSequenceNumber as string,
		PaymentName as string,
		PaymentId as string,
		PaymentCurrency as string,
		PaymentAmount as decimal(26,2),
		PaymentExchangeRate as decimal(26,0),
		PaymentAmountDefaultCurrency as string,
		PaymentDueDate as string,
		PaymentCreateDate as string,
		PaymentStatus as string,
		PaymentCheckNumber as string,
		PaymentTransactionId as string,
		PaymentDescription as string,
		PaymentTypeName as string,
		PaymentTypeDescription as string,
		PaymentPaymentDate as string,
		Budget as string,
		BudgetGroup as string,
		BudgetAmount as decimal(26,2),
		BudgetStartDate as string,
		BudgetEndDate as string,
		BudgetFiscalYear as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearName as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearStartDate as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearEndDate as string,
		OrganizationName as string,
		ProposalId as string,
		OrganizationTaxId as string,
		OrganizationCategory as string,
		BudgetCategory as string,
		BudgetQuantity as string,
		PaymentItemPrice as string,
		PaymentItemQuantity as string,
		PaymentTaxEligibility as string,
		PaymentMethodName as string,
		DistributionId as string,
		DistributionAmount as decimal(26,2),
		DistributionCode1 as string,
		DistributionCode2 as string,
		DistributionCode3 as string,
		DistributionCode4 as string,
		DistributionCode5 as string,
		DistributionCode6 as string,
		DistributionCode7 as string,
		DistributionCode8 as string,
		DistributionCode9 as string,
		DistributionCode10 as string,
		BudgetID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Snapshot_Asof_Date = $RunDate,
		Snapshot_Active_Flag = 'Y') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		DistributionCode1 as string,
		PaymentExchangeRate as integer,
		DistributionCode2 as string,
		DistributionCode3 as string,
		DistributionCode4 as string,
		PaymentSequenceNumber as string,
		PaymentAmountDefaultCurrency as string,
		DistributionCode5 as string,
		DistributionCode6 as string,
		DistributionCode7 as string,
		BudgetID as string,
		PaymentName as string,
		DistributionCode8 as string,
		DistributionCode9 as string,
		PaymentCurrency as string,
		PaymentDescription as string,
		PaymentItemQuantity as string,
		PaymentAmount as integer,
		BudgetFiscalYear as string,
		PaymentTypeName as string,
		PaymentStatus as string,
		PaymentPaymentDate as string,
		SNAPSHOT_AS_OF_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BudgetQuantity as string,
		OrganizationCategory as string,
		PaymentTransactionId as string,
		OrganizationName as string,
		BudgetEndDate as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearName as string,
		PaymentItemPrice as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearEndDate as string,
		BudgetAmount as integer,
		SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_FLAG as string,
		PaymentDueDate as string,
		PaymentMethodName as string,
		BudgetCategory as string,
		BudgetStartDate as string,
		PaymentTypeDescription as string,
		Budget as string,
		BudgetGroup as string,
		PaymentCreateDate as string,
		PaymentId as string,
		PaymentTaxEligibility as string,
		DistributionId as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearStartDate as string,
		PaymentCheckNumber as string,
		OrganizationTaxId as string,
		DistributionAmount as integer,
		ProposalId as string,
		DistributionCode10 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DistributionCode1,
		PaymentExchangeRate,
		DistributionCode2,
		DistributionCode3,
		DistributionCode4,
		PaymentSequenceNumber,
		PaymentAmountDefaultCurrency,
		DistributionCode5,
		DistributionCode6,
		DistributionCode7,
		BudgetID,
		PaymentName,
		DistributionCode8,
		DistributionCode9,
		PaymentCurrency,
		PaymentDescription,
		PaymentItemQuantity,
		PaymentAmount,
		BudgetFiscalYear,
		PaymentTypeName,
		PaymentStatus,
		PaymentPaymentDate,
		SNAPSHOT_AS_OF_DATE = Snapshot_Asof_Date,
		BudgetQuantity,
		OrganizationCategory,
		PaymentTransactionId,
		OrganizationName,
		BudgetEndDate,
		BudgetFiscalYearName,
		PaymentItemPrice,
		BudgetFiscalYearEndDate,
		BudgetAmount,
		SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_FLAG = Snapshot_Active_Flag,
		PaymentDueDate,
		PaymentMethodName,
		BudgetCategory,
		BudgetStartDate,
		PaymentTypeDescription,
		Budget,
		BudgetGroup,
		PaymentCreateDate,
		PaymentId,
		PaymentTaxEligibility,
		DistributionId,
		BudgetFiscalYearStartDate,
		PaymentCheckNumber,
		OrganizationTaxId,
		DistributionAmount,
		ProposalId,
		DistributionCode10),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
